description: Eval golden set — specs/acceptance.md: 6 Tamil, 3 Mandarin, 3 Malay everyday moments, plus 2 ambiguous moments that must pause for clarification (F3). Each runs the full 6-agent pipeline; structural + safety criteria are checked automatically.

moments.text: We fed the pigeons at the void deck after breakfast
She helped Amma water the money plant on the corridor
He stacked his blocks into a tall tower and it toppled over
We bought rambutans at the wet market and she carried the bag
He found a snail on the corridor wall after the rain
She drew a big yellow bus and stuck it on the fridge
He helped fold the laundry and matched all the socks
We saw a cat sleeping under the mama shop shelf
She packed her school bag all by herself tonight
He shared his biscuits with his little cousin at the table
We watched the MRT trains go by from the overhead bridge
She put all her toy cars back into the red box before bed
